AUTHOR: Cai
TITLE: Semi-supervised Visual Tracking of Marine Animals Using Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
REGION: Puerto Rico; St. John, U.S. Virgin Islands; Pacific midwater (Mesobot); WHOI REMUS deployments
SPECIES: 17 marine animal types incl. 9 fish taxa (striped fish, parrotfish, lionfish, angelfish, boxfish, snapper, barracuda, jack, blue tang) plus octopus, sharks, dolphins, jellyfish, squid, etc.
DATA: Own VMAT dataset (33 sequences, 74K frames) from diver GoPro, REMUS AUV, Mesobot; plus in-situ AUV (CUREE) field trials
V_EV: Table 3/Fig. 6: attributes 'Active Lighting: Scene is predominantly illuminated by AUV/diver' vs 'Passive Lighting'; Table 2 habitat 'Midwater, turbid'
D_EV: no statement found (Sec. 3: VMAT 'is used for evaluation only'; trackers 'pre-trained (using generic datasets)', run as provided)
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'All these algorithms utilize pre-trained (using generic datasets) deep convolutional neural networks'; evaluated on underwater VMAT, no in-domain scores reported
E_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'we consider the (1) success rate, (2) precision, and normalized precision metrics accumulated across all frames in each sequence'
ARCH: 13 semi-supervised single-object trackers (KeepTrack/KeepTrackFast, SuperDiMP, DiMP, PrDiMP, TrDiMP, TrSiam, TransT, SiamRPN++, SiamMask, DaSiamRPN, ATOM, ECO)
METR: success AUC, precision@20px, normalized precision, FPS
NOTE: INCL borderline: multi-taxon single-object tracking; fish are ~half of sequences but quantitative results are reported only for the whole dataset and by attribute (no fish-specific numbers); AUV field trials on barracuda/jacks are qualitative. Coded Y for verifier review. No training/split: off-the-shelf trackers pretrained on generic datasets evaluated on VMAT -> D1 NR; R1=Y because models trained elsewhere tested on underwater data, but no in-domain numbers in paper (R3=N). V6=P: success per active vs passive lighting and midwater/seabed attribute subsets (Fig. 6), categorical not measured. Depth: Mesobot twilight zone 100-3000 m and AUV depth profiles. AUV trajectory (Fig. 9) shown as proxy for animal track but not evaluated -> E1 없음.
AUTHORS_FULL: Cai, L; McGuire, NE; Hanlon, R; Mooney, TA; Girdhar, Y
